name: ClickUp
summary: The 'everything app' for project and work management. Centralize your tasks, docs, sprints, and team communication in one hub.
best_for: teams that want one highly customizable app for tasks, docs, goals and reporting and will invest in setting it up
skip_if: you want something simple your team adopts in a day — ClickUp's depth becomes overwhelm for a light use case
honest_knock: The everything-app breadth is also the downside — it's feature-dense with a real learning curve, and teams can drown in options. Powerful and cheap per seat, but only if you'll actually configure and adopt it.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-13, read on their own pricing page with both billing tabs open; every amount unchanged on 2026-09-30) A Free Forever plan with unlimited tasks but 60MB of storage; Unlimited $7 and Business $12 per user/month billed yearly, which are $10 and $19 billed monthly; Enterprise is quote-only. AI is priced on top of the plan: Brain AI $9 and Everything AI $28 per user/month. On 2026-09-30 the AI section also listed what the AI plans include: Brain AI adds 1,500 AI Super Credits per user a month and Everything AI 5,000, shared across the Workspace, with extra credits at $10 per 10,000.
